summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K furnishing exhibits related to the issuance of $1.5B aggregate liquidation preference of 7.250% Non-Step-Up Non-Cumulative Contingent Convertible Perpetual Preferred Tier 1 Securities under an F-3 shelf. The underwriting agreement, indenture, and supplemental indenture are attached. This is a routine capital markets debt offering, not a special-situation event.
